title: Choose when to generate compiled models and queries
goal: Choose generation stages for an EF application, using a tested CLI compiled-model alternative when automatic build scaffolding cannot load the application.

selectionNotes: SDK11.0.100/EF11.0.0 clean automatic model-build failure reproduced. Tested bounded alternative: dotnet-ef11.0.0 CLI model generation, compiled generated model, Tasks publish query interceptors and executed published SQLite app using that model. No NativeAOT or universal query-shape claim.
